title: Forms with JavaScript: the browser stops an empty required field, the server marks a bypassed one and announces it, and a filled form is sent without reloading
description: A visitor of the forms module's form (the FORM of modules/forms/tests/lib.mjs, the check compares them) with JavaScript, in the order a visitor would hit them on the same form: native HTML5 validation stops an empty required field (no request goes out); with «required» removed by hand the server answers, the page marks the field (aria-invalid, its error, the aria-live status) and puts the focus on it; filled, it is sent through the Interactivity API without reloading, announced in the polite live region, the form cleared, and stored once with its three notifications. The anti-spam minimum fill time is 0 here (min_seconds): it is the server's, tested at level 2 (server.test.mjs), and waiting it out would be a fixed wait. Read by browser-forms-js. It was the JS cases of browser.test.mjs (level 3) until 29-10-2026.
